editorial.description_en: The last light of an autumn day, when the red has gone dark without going brown.
editorial.description_ja: 秋の夕暮れのような、暗く濃い赤。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.380, C 0.112, h 32.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 秋 (aki, autumn) + 夕 (yū, evening). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Autumn Dusk" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 秋夕. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — koi-tsuchi at ΔE00 4.7, sabi-iwa at ΔE00 8.4, yama-moe at ΔE00 9.1. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (212°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
